rich_narrative.summary: ICNA Chicago Illinois operates as a non-ethnic, non-sectarian Islamic organization dedicated to community service and educational outreach. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">total revenue of $1,386,389</cite> to support its religious and social missions. The charity maintains a <cite id="1">92/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting a strong commitment to accountability and financial health. Its operations are characterized by a <cite id="1">70.5% program expense ratio</cite>, which meets the baseline for community-focused nonprofits. While the organization demonstrates <cite id="1">high fundraising efficiency</cite> by spending only $0.08 to raise every $1, it currently holds <cite id="1">35.4 months of working capital</cite> in reserve. This level of liquidity is significantly higher than the industry standard and suggests a potential delay in deploying donor funds toward active programs. The organization provides <cite id="2">zakat-eligible services</cite> across several categories, including aid for the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin). Its programs, such as <cite id="6">GainPeace and ICNA Relief</cite>, focus on direct service delivery within the Illinois region. Despite its strong administrative ratings, the charity lacks <cite id="6">third-party impact evaluations</cite> to verify the long-term effectiveness of its social programs. Donors can expect a balanced organization that is administratively sound but would benefit from greater transparency regarding its <cite id="6">cost-per-beneficiary metrics</cite> and reserve management.
